run_Kronos_webui: run the Kronos Web UI Flask server on localhost port 7070 with auto browser open
check_dependencies_Kronos: check if flask, flask_cors, pandas, numpy, and plotly dependencies are installed
install_dependencies_Kronos: install Kronos Web UI dependencies from requirements.txt using pip
run_Kronos_with_model: run the Kronos Web UI with Kronos, KronosTokenizer, and KronosPredictor model library loaded
run_Kronos_simulated: run the Kronos Web UI in simulated prediction mode when model library is not available
